items.label: Game list
items.text: Every [section] of games.ini with the machine it needs; double-click or Return plays it.

items.label: Title and target
items.text: Machine, port directory and the 8.3 program name autostarted as C:\<program>.

items.label: Screenshot
items.text: The image named by the game's screenshot key, from the port's docs/.

items.label: Description and controls
items.text: The description and controls keys from games.ini.

items.label: Actions
items.text: Play (optionally make first, sound on/off) starts Hatari on the right machine through hatari-agent-run.sh; Stop Hatari quits it; Agent console opens hatari_gui.py on the same port.

items.label: Status line
items.text: Last log line: game count, then build and start-up messages.
